summary: Iteration 54 - Ambassador Access System Testing Complete. Backend: 9/9 tests passed. Frontend: Premium Gates working correctly (3 gates visible for Smart Map, AI Assistant, Secret Tips). All existing CTAs (TopBookingBar, ContextualCTAs, StickyBar) still functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/ambassador/features (anonymous) - returns is_ambassador=false, all features=false
Backend: GET /api/ambassador/features (with auth) - returns ambassador status and feature flags
Backend: GET /api/ambassador/progress requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: GET /api/ambassador/progress returns correct structure (is_ambassador, valid_referrals, required=3, remaining, progress_pct, referrals, premium_features)
Backend: POST /api/ambassador/generate-referral requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: POST /api/ambassador/generate-referral (with auth) generates referral_code and journey_id
Backend: Referral code generation is idempotent (same code returned on multiple calls)
Backend: Anti-abuse - self-referral prevention working (user cannot count as own referral)
Backend: New user starts with valid_referrals=0, required=3, remaining=3, is_ambassador=false
Frontend: Travel plan generation works (Lisboa, Cultural, 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-05)
Frontend: Smart Map preview (data-testid='smart-map-preview') appears blurred/locked with 'Mapa interativo para Embaixadores'
Frontend: AI Assistant preview (data-testid='ai-assistant-preview') appears blurred/locked with 'Assistente IA para Embaixadores'
Frontend: Secret Tips gated with 'Dicas secretas para Embaixadores' (first 3 tips visible, rest gated)
Frontend: TopBookingBar (data-testid='top-booking-bar') working with destination-aware labels
Frontend: StickyBar (data-testid='sticky-booking-bar') working with destination-specific CTAs
Frontend: Ambassador badge NOT shown for non-ambassador user (correct behavior)
Frontend: All contextual CTAs still functional (booking, skyscanner, getyourguide, airalo, insurance)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py (lines 1113-1329): Ambassador system endpoints properly implemented with recalculate_ambassador_status() function
Backend server.py (lines 59-76): Anti-abuse self-referral prevention in registration - checks sponsor email != new user email
Backend server.py (line 1115): AMBASSADOR_REQUIRED_REFERRALS = 3 constant properly defined
Frontend AmbassadorProgress.js: Component properly exports both AmbassadorProgress and PremiumGate
Frontend AmbassadorProgress.js (lines 58-71): Ambassador badge shown only when is_ambassador=true (data-testid='ambassador-badge')
Frontend AmbassadorProgress.js (lines 213-228): PremiumGate component properly implements blur effect and lock overlay
Frontend TravelPlanner.js (lines 1003-1005): AmbassadorProgress shown only for logged-in non-ambassador users
Frontend TravelPlanner.js (lines 977-1000): Smart Map and AI Assistant properly gated with PremiumGate
Frontend TravelPlanner.js (lines 954-965): Secret tips properly gated (first 3 visible, rest behind PremiumGate)
test_credentials: Test users created with prefix TEST_amb_, TEST_auth_, TEST_selfref_ via API
seed_data_creation: Generated travel plans: Lisboa (Cultural), Porto (Gastronómica), Barcelona (Aventura)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 54 verified Ambassador Access System. Key findings: 1) Backend endpoints working: GET /api/ambassador/features (anonymous + auth), GET /api/ambassador/progress (auth required), POST /api/ambassador/generate-referral (auth required). 2) Anti-abuse: self-referral prevention working. 3) Frontend: 3 PremiumGate components visible for Smart Map, AI Assistant, Secret Tips. 4) AmbassadorProgress component shows for logged-in non-ambassador users. 5) All existing CTAs (TopBookingBar, ContextualCTAs, StickyBar) still functional. 6) Ambassador badge only shown for ambassadors. 7) AMBASSADOR_REQUIRED_REFERRALS = 3.
